subject: Re: Status: ingestion done, rater throughput risk
body:
Team,

Decisions from Monday's review:

1. Workflow cut: the costed report covers 8 of the 11 collection workflows. We drop the three pure-machine variants — they're dominated on quality and aren't candidates for the standard pipeline anyway. This absorbs the rater delay without moving launch review, which stays the week of 7/20.
2. Pipeline pick, pending final numbers: LLM-assisted post-editing as default, from-scratch human reserved for high-stakes domains. Efe's analysis memo is due 7/15 to lock this.
3. Distillation recipe: v0 student is within 1.1 MQM-weighted points of the teacher — good enough to keep investing; Gustavo continues per the six-week plan.

Amara, please book the Launch Review Board slot with Nadia's office this week.

Priya
